zones.label: Sun
zones.summary: Sun protection reduces skin and heat risks during outdoor time.
facts: Use shade, hats, protective clothing, and sunscreen with adult guidance.
Drink water and take cooling breaks.
Protection matters even when the air feels cool.

zones.label: Loud Sound
zones.summary: Very loud sound can hurt hearing even when it is temporary.
facts: Move farther from loud speakers or equipment.
Tell an adult if ears ring or sound feels painful.

zones.label: Chemicals
zones.summary: Household and garden chemicals require adult control and secure storage.
facts: Do not touch or taste an unknown substance.
Keep containers closed, high, or locked.
Tell an adult about leaks or spills.

zones.label: Water
zones.summary: Clear-looking natural water is not automatically safe to drink.
facts: Use a known safe refill source.
Ask a trusted adult before drinking unknown water.
Water safety also includes supervision near creeks and pools.

zones.label: Germs
zones.summary: Shared outdoor equipment and coughs can move germs between people.
facts: Wash hands before eating and after dirty play.
Community cleaning and safe water support everyone.
